# Luke Libby

> Creative Technologist and Product Builder

Portfolio of product work by Luke Libby — AI workflows, internal tools, outdoor products, and learning systems.

## Site
- [Home](https://lukelibby.com/): Luke Libby — Creative Technologist and Product Builder. AI workflows, internal tools, and digital systems.
- [Work archive](https://lukelibby.com/work): Archive of product stories, brand systems, and earlier work by Luke Libby.

## Work
- [OVRmaps](https://lukelibby.com/work/ovrmaps): Outdoor platform for maps, GPS recording, trail observations, and community sharing.
- [WyldTracks](https://lukelibby.com/work/wyldtracks): Wildlife field journal with evidence-backed IDs, GBIF validation, and a personal observation record.
- [Play It Pro](https://lukelibby.com/work/play-it-pro): Music education platform for teachers, students, and tutorial authors.
- [SlideKit](https://lukelibby.com/work/slidekit): PowerPoint add-in for catching presentation standards problems before video production.
- [VideoKit](https://lukelibby.com/work/videokit): Internal video review workflow for findings, status, and standards checks in one place.
- [Plottr](https://lukelibby.com/work/plottr): Presentation review that imports a deck, checks it, and exports actionable findings.
- [Luma](https://lukelibby.com/work/luma): Technology-course review system for objectives, concepts, procedures, and tools.
- [AI-Assisted Lab Production](https://lukelibby.com/work/ai-lab-production): AI-assisted hands-on lab production workflow with human review gates intact.

## Brand & Interface Systems
- [Terrapin Outdoors](https://lukelibby.com/brand-systems/terrapin-outdoors): Map-first outdoor platform design system with foundations, map shells, and field-ready components.
- [Replenish Health](https://lukelibby.com/brand-systems/replenish-health): Dark-mode design system for a health platform with brand pillars, tokens, and dashboard UI.
